source.title: Understanding Dataset Difficulty with V-Usable Information
source.venue: Proceedings of the 39th International Conference on Machine Learning (PMLR 162)

confidence_rationale: Supports INV-104's MEASUREMENT PREMISE rather than its substantive assertion, and is scored accordingly. What it establishes -- with a formal treatment and an ICML outstanding-paper level of scrutiny -- is that 'how much information X carries about Y' is only well-posed relative to a bounded family V of extractors, so 'the distinction is present in the latent' and 'the distinction is usable by anything downstream' are different quantities that can and do come apart. That is exactly the T1/T2 split INV-104 builds its falsifier on, and exactly the gap V3-EXQ-978 (r2 0.710/0.858) and V3-EXQ-948 (downstream reader at 0.5 res/ep) fell into. Confidence held at 0.62 because the domain is NLP dataset difficulty, not representation compression in an embodied agent, and because the paper says nothing about WHICH distinctions matter.
failure_signatures: A linear probe reporting high r2 on a frozen representation certifies only that the class is present to the probe's own function family; it licenses no inference about whether a downstream policy of different capacity can use it. INV-104's own history is an instance: V3-EXQ-978 measured the class-1 field linearly decodable at r2 0.710 sense-path / 0.858 encoder-path while V3-EXQ-948 measured a downstream reader on that same latent at 0.5 res/ep against a 1.0 competence floor.

Because V-usable information is defined relative to V, a retained-fraction statistic like INV-104's R_k is only interpretable if the adapter family is held FIXED across the compressed, raw-input-ceiling and untrained-projection arms. A capacity difference between arms silently redefines the quantity being compared, and the resulting R_k is a statement about the adapters, not about the compression.

V-information can be NEGATIVE relative to a family, i.e. conditioning on the representation can make a bounded extractor worse than the label prior. A near-zero or sub-floor R_k is therefore not automatically evidence that the class was destroyed; it can equally be evidence that the representation's geometry is adversarial to the adapter family -- MECH-517's H-C route, not a preservation failure.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Dataset difficulty is framed 'with respect to a model V as the lack of V-usable information (Xu et al., 2019), where a lower value indicates a more difficult dataset for V'. V-usable information measures 'how much information an input variable X can provide about Y when constrained to functions V'; pointwise V-information (PVI) gives the per-instance version. The framework permits comparing datasets and slices for a fixed model, rather than comparing models on a fixed dataset.
mapping.ree_translation: INV-104's wording 'must preserve, OR leave recoverable through its dynamics' is a claim about usable information, not about information simpliciter -- and the claim's own falsifier says so, by making R_k rather than probe r2 the verdict statistic. This paper is the formal warrant for that design choice: information content is only defined relative to a bounded extractor family, so T1 (presence, via a linear/ridge probe) and T2 (recoverability-in-use, via a capacity-matched adapter behaviour-cloning an oracle) measure genuinely different quantities and may disagree. It also supplies the discipline that makes R_k meaningful: the extractor family must be held fixed across the compressed, ceiling and untrained-projection arms, which is what NDP-4's same-capacity floor arm already enforces.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The domain transfer is real and should not be glossed. This is NLP dataset difficulty -- text classification benchmarks, transformer fine-tuning -- not an embodied agent's world-model compression, and the paper's target is annotation artefacts in datasets rather than developmental adequacy of a latent. The transferred content is the formal point about extractor-relative information, which is domain-general; nothing about the paper's empirical results transfers. Critically, the paper is silent on INV-104's actual substance: it tells you how to ask whether a distinction is usable, and nothing at all about which distinctions an organism must keep.
mapping.source_context: NLP; dataset difficulty and annotation artefacts in benchmarks such as SNLI, MultiNLI, CoLA. ICML 2022 outstanding paper.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality is high (ICML outstanding paper, formal result building on Xu et al.'s predictive V-information). Mapping fidelity is deliberately mid: the paper is methodological warrant for the falsifier's two-tier design, not evidence about the preservation contract, and I have not inflated the direction to compensate. Transfer risk 0.40 -- the domain gap is large but the transferred content is a definitional point rather than an empirical finding.
